sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:51776
Court No. - 75
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 11653 of 2025
Applicant :- Harish Saraswat And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Short Counter affidavit filed by Sri Vinod Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the opposite party
no.2 is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Vinod Kumar Shukla,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned AGA for the State.
3.

The instant application has been filed for quashing the entire criminal proceeding in Case No.
3261 of 2017, arising out of Case Crime No.241 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 509 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants as well as opposite party no.2 jointly submitted that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise.

The aforesaid compromise dated 18.02.2025 is reduced in Harish Saraswat And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37442506/
1 written compromise and also annexed at page 9 of the short counter affidavit.

entities.text: Harish Saraswat And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that the aforesaid compromise has already been filed before the court below.
It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of aforesaid compromise.
5. Though this fact has not been disputed by learned AGA but he has raised a preliminary objection that the aforesaid proceeding cannot be quashed on the basis of compromise.
The aforesaid compromise should be verified by the court below before quashing the impugned proceeding.
6. In view of the above, the court below is directed to verify the aforesaid compromise within a period of two months, from the date of presentation of a copy of this order,
after summoning the parties and after verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
7. For a period of two months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
9. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 9.4.2025 A.Kr.
